name: branch8-auth-check
description: One place for every sign-in the Branch8 setup needs - Jira (atlassian MCP), GitHub (gh CLI; the github MCP is optional), Devin DeepWiki (devin MCP) and Gemini (only for image generation). Shows one status line on the first turn, and when a task needs a service that is not signed in, asks with a card and walks the user through sign-in - or tells them who to ask for an account. Covers official plugins too, which cannot be changed. Adds /auth-check.
